summary: Judicator Lord Anneliesis is returning in a limited-time anniversary banner on November 8th according to news from the Chinese version of Dragonheir. While the exact release date for global servers is not yet confirmed, her return is expected later this year. Global server timing may differ slightly due to anniversary schedule adjustments, similar to how Child of Chaos was released. Aura mains are strongly advised to start saving Heliolite Dice now to pull Anneliesis and obtain her inspirations.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Returning on a limited-time banner; highly recommended for Aura teams with several inspirations if possible.

tips: Start saving Heliolite Dice for the upcoming Anneliesis banner rerun if you plan to play Aura teams.
title: MUST WATCH! Anneliesis Return Looks Very Likely | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
